summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for Spring Boot 3.0 embedded MongoDB test infrastructure migration. It addresses a specific dependency substitution problem (Flapdoodle vs. Testcontainers) with clear workflow and constraints. No existing skill in the registry covers this capability. Peer candidates address different Spring Boot 3.0 migration concerns (SAML2, metrics observation) and are not related. Existing skills are unrelated (Flink data sources, watermarks). The candidate has valid support evidence from Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide and no conflicts.
